event.title: SFSCON '26 - "Let’s toot together! The Fediverse for outreach for organizations" in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Tobias Diekershoff and Ana Galan will have a conversation about the Fediverse and how the FSFE uses it. Tobias will provide a recap of what the Fediverse is and why the concept of ‘reach’ on Big Tech platforms is misleading. Then, Ana will explain which social media channels the FSFE uses and why the Fediverse is our main tool. Come along to find out why decentralised tools are essential for achieving digital sovereignty in the social media sphere.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 1.
